tables.name: Nareth Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Nareth settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%). Placeholder starter sounds awaiting editorial work: not established Nareth vocabulary, and no meanings are implied.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: Two starter sounds joined directly, e.g. Naroneth, Korivai.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: A founder name joined directly to an ending, e.g. Talarien, Ivaramar.
